title: Quick Picks for Employee Panel
summary:
*   City leaders held a special meeting with one item on the agenda: appointing members to the Employee Suggestion Box Panel.
*   Six diverse individuals, including a former city council member and representatives from local commerce and civic groups, were selected for the panel.
*   This panel's role is to manage and review suggestions submitted by city employees.
*   Notably, the entire meeting concluded in just two minutes.
transcript:
